messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SDE IC candidate debrief — score reconciliation and closure

Team — quick one: Elena Park finished the onsite yesterday. I pulled the scorecard and there are some wide variances across the panel (notably system design vs. coding). I want us to close this out today so recruiting can make an offer or move on.

Can each of you do two things by 11:30am PT?
- Add a 1-2 sentence justification in the scorecard (link below) for any score you gave that is 2+ points different from the panel median.
- Reply here with a single-line motion: +1 (hire), 0 (hold), -1 (no hire).

Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/scorecards/SDE-IC/elena-park-2027
Attachment: scoring_matrix.csv (exported from scorecard)

Context quick notes:
- Interview order: coding -> system design -> behavioral
- Primary concerns called out by interviews: limited large-scale caching knowledge, strong ownership examples

If we have split votes after 11:30 I’ll call a 15-min sync with anyone who wants to make their case.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Staff Eng, Hiring Committee
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SDE IC candidate debrief — score reconciliation and closure

+1 (hire) from me — strong ownership examples and clear trade-offs in the design interview.

Quick justification: I scored System Design a 3 while the median is 5 because I was looking for concrete caching strategies at scale (LRU variants, sharding approach) and Elena stayed higher-level. However, her coding and behavioral signals are high (5s) and she demonstrated a pragmatic approach to trade-offs which matters more for this role.

I exported a quick matrix and attached it (scoring_matrix.csv).

Marissa
Sr. Eng Manager

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

0 (hold) — I think Elena has the core skills but I want one follow-up to validate depth on distributed caches and eventual consistency scenarios. My justification is in the shared scorecard; I marked design at 4 while the panel median is 5.

If we can do a 25-minute deep-dive with engineering (not system design whiteboard) to ask specific cache/consistency scenarios, I’ll move to +1. Otherwise I lean hold.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SDE IC candidate debrief — score reconciliation and closure

Thanks all. Quick summary and motion:
- Marissa: +1 (hire) — coding+behavior strong, design pragmatic.
- Laura: 0 (hold) — wants targeted follow-up on cache/consistency.
- Mina: (see below)

Proposal: do a 25-min targeted follow-up with Markus (staff SRE) and me today at 3pm PT to ask 4 specific cache/consistency prompts. If Laura moves to +1 after, we proceed to offer at comp band B with standard equity. If Laura remains 0, we put a hold and route to another hire cycle.

Action items (owners):
- Jonas: schedule follow-up + send prompts (I will).
- Marissa: confirm availability for offer discussion if we get +1.
- Laura: list 3 must-ask prompts for the follow-up (deadline 12:15pm PT).
- Mina: capture final scoring and publish to candidate tracker after follow-up.

I’m attaching the interview notes (interview-notes-20270516.pdf) for anyone who wants the verbatim question/answer snippets.

Jonas
